item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

answer_sheet.Exact on-screen copy:
Scene 1: Less scrolling. More doing.
Scene 2: Plan your day in one place.
Scene 3: Try DayNest today.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and green with simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes; layout and font are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Silent; English text exactly as supplied.

must_haves: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.

turns.text: make an ad for my planning app

dialog.agent:
I'd be glad to make this ad. I just need a few details before I start:

1. How long should it be?
2. Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
3. Should it have sound: music, a voice, or silent?

It would also help to know:
- **What's the app called?** Do you want any words on screen, like the name, a slogan or a call to action such as "Download now"? If so, send them exactly as you want them shown.
- **What does it do best?** For example: daily to-dos, calendars, team projects or habit tracking.
- **Do you have any images?** A logo or app screenshots would let me show the real product rather than a made-up one.
dialog.why: The reply asks the user for details (length, platform, sound, app name, features, assets) and waits before starting.

dialog.agent:
Okay, 9 seconds. Two more quick questions:

1. Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
2. Should it have sound: music, a voice, or silent?

And if you want the app's name or a slogan on screen, send it exactly as it should appear. If you'd rather have no words, just say so.
dialog.why: The reply asks the user where the video will be shown, whether it should have sound, and what on-screen text to use, then waits for answers.
dialog.user: idk where, just make it wide like youtube

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the ad. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created and no credits were used.

A 9-second wide video at 480p (the free plan's video quality) costs about 216 credits (24 per second). I can't see your exact balance from here. You can check it on your Magic Hour account page.

What you can do:
1. **Add credits** (or upgrade your plan) on Magic Hour, then tell me and I'll make the same video.
2. **Make it shorter.** Each second costs about 24 credits, so 4–5 seconds would be roughly 100–120. I don't know if your balance covers that, though.
3. **Make a still image ad instead.** Wide images cost only about 5–10 credits each.

The ad I tried to make: a person at a sunny desk opens a colorful planner app on their phone, and their stressed look turns into a relaxed smile. It's silent with no words on screen, since you hadn't given me a name or slogan. If you send your app's name, a slogan or a screenshot, I can use them in whichever option you pick.
